cost_basis: runtime-only estimate; excludes idle VM time
footprint_description: EPSG:2193 XY coordinate-envelope rectangle of the exact filtered full-density input LAZ; technical tile-throughput proxy, not site area or occupied-cell union
area_measurement_record: laspy.open(input).header.mins/maxs, width × height / 1,000,000; gaps and empty corners within envelope are included
note: Use the footprint actually processed. Do not divide full-tile runtime by the small reference-site area; declare preprocessing, I/O, inference and container startup inclusions. Runtime estimates are not invoices.
